verdict.rationale: Lithic documents issuing virtual and physical cards via API, program-level controls, a Lithic-run KYC process, and network chargeback filing. A community comment calls it a "card issuing as a service" provider, which implies the platform carries some program-management burden. Nothing in the pack addresses BIN sponsorship, network membership, or bank partners, and the same comment notes that compliance and legal work still falls on the builder. missing for 10: documented BIN sponsorship/issuing-bank arrangement, network membership handled by the platform, explicit program-management scope, documented signup-to-first-live-card timeline.
